const wasmPath = process.argv[2];
if (!wasmPath) {
  throw new Error("round-trip.mjs requires a path to the reference .wasm fixture");

const wasmBytes = readFileSync(wasmPath);

function reversed(bytes) {
  return Uint8Array.from(bytes).reverse();
}

let failed = 0;
let passed = 0;

async function test(name, fn) {
  try {
    await fn();
    passed += 1;
    console.log(`ok - ${name}`);
  } catch (error) {
    failed += 1;
    console.error(`FAIL - ${name}`);
    console.error(error);
  }
}
